items.criterion: Search Amazon for hard-shell carry-on luggage
items.description: Use Amazon (amazon.com is acceptable) to search for hard-shell carry-on luggage and reach a results/browse page showing relevant products. Full credit if a relevant search is performed and results are displayed. Full credit also if access is blocked by CAPTCHA/login/robot checks or regional gating and the agent clearly reports the blocker and makes reasonable attempts (e.g., refresh, try a slightly different navigation/search within Amazon). Partial credit if the search is overly broad but still reaches luggage results related to carry-on/hard-shell.

items.criterion: Apply visible filters: Prime-eligible, 4+ stars, and $60–$140
items.description: Use Amazon’s visible filters/controls to narrow results to Prime-eligible items rated at least 4 stars and priced $60–$140. Full credit if all three constraints are applied via filters OR if Amazon’s UI does not reliably support one/more filters (missing, broken, A/B UI, requires sign-in) and the agent compensates by manually verifying Prime eligibility, star rating, and in-range price on each selected listing and explicitly notes the limitation. Partial credit if only two constraints are filtered/verified when the third is reasonably available, or if the agent doesn’t notice a selected variant/price falls outside the range and doesn’t correct it when possible.

Open three distinct product listings that meet the constraints (hard-shell carry-on; Prime-eligible; rating ≥ 4 stars; price $60–$140 for the selected/visible variant). Full credit if three qualifying listings are opened. If fewer than three qualifying items are available due to filtering limits, dynamic pricing/variant availability, shipping location differences, or Amazon restricting access, award full credit when the agent opens as many qualifying listings as reasonably possible (at least two if available) and clearly explains why a third could not be found. Partial credit if the agent opens fewer than three without clear justification, or includes a non-qualifying item when qualifying alternatives are visible and accessible.

items.criterion: Extract and compare required attributes across the three listings
items.description: For each opened listing, extract (as visible on the page) and compare: price, dimensions, weight, warranty, and review count. Full credit if all attributes are provided for all three, OR if one/more attributes are not shown on Amazon for a listing and the agent explicitly marks them as not visible/not stated (without fabricating) while still comparing the remaining attributes. Partial credit if multiple attributes are missing due to insufficient effort to locate product details/specs (when available), or if the comparison is incomplete/unclear. No credit for hallucinated specs, warranty terms, or review counts.

items.criterion: Recommend the best option for international cabin travel (no purchase)
items.description: Recommend the best option for international cabin travel based on the comparison (e.g., carry-on dimensions suitability, lower weight, warranty signals, review volume/value). Must explicitly avoid purchasing/checkout. Full credit if the recommendation is clearly justified using the compared attributes and acknowledges international cabin considerations (size/weight). Partial credit if a recommendation is given with weak linkage to the extracted attributes or omits international cabin relevance. No credit if the agent attempts to purchase or proceed to checkout.
